# CLI commands (`@comforge/cli` 0.5.0)

Global flags: `--compact`, `--cwd`, `--help`, `--json`, `--summary`, `--version`.

Flags are what the argument parser accepts (`KNOWN_FLAGS`); a flag marked * is accepted but not shown in the command's usage line.

| Command | Usage | Flags | Writes | Dry run by default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `init` | `comforge init [--write] [--force]` | `--force` `--write` | repository file, only with --write | yes |
| `doctor` | `comforge doctor` | — | none | — |
| `capabilities` | `comforge capabilities` | — | none | — |
| `context` | `comforge context [--task TEXT] \| context check` | `--task` | none | — |
| `schema` | `comforge schema <config\|capabilities>` | — | none | — |
| `start` | `comforge start <TICKET[.phase]> [--issue N] [--expect-digest HEX] [--no-provision]` | `--expect-digest` `--issue` `--no-provision` `--reopen`* | local checkout and state | — |
| `revise` | `comforge revise <PR> [--reviewed-head SHA] [--no-provision]` | `--no-provision` `--reviewed-head` | local state | — |
| `status` | `comforge status [TICKET[.phase]]` | — | none | — |
| `verify` | `comforge verify <TICKET[.phase]> [--commit SHA] [--with NAME[,NAME]] [--keep]` | `--commit` `--keep` `--with` | local state | — |
| `publish` | `comforge publish <TICKET[.phase]> --title TEXT [--draft] [--grant FILE] [--execute]` | `--closes`* `--draft` `--execute` `--grant` `--title` | git push, GitHub pull request | yes |
| `complete` | `comforge complete --result FILE [--grant FILE] [--execute]` | `--execute` `--grant` `--result` | GitHub issue comment, PR body | yes |
| `deliver` | `comforge deliver <TICKET[.phase]> --title TEXT --result FILE [--no-pr] [--draft] [--grant FILE] [--execute]` | `--closes`* `--draft` `--execute` `--grant` `--no-pr` `--result` `--title` | as publish and complete | yes |
| `grant` | `comforge grant template <ID> [--hours N] \| grant sign <ID> --grant FILE --key FILE` | `--command`* `--grant` `--hours` `--key` | none | — |
| `recover` | `comforge recover <TICKET[.phase]> [--abandon] [--grant FILE] [--execute]` | `--abandon` `--execute` `--grant` | write ledger | yes |
| `cleanup` | `comforge cleanup <PR\|TICKET[.phase]> [--allow-missing-completion] [--grant FILE] [--execute]` | `--allow-missing-completion` `--execute` `--grant` | local checkout and state | yes |
| `migrate` | `comforge migrate [--rollback] [--wait SECONDS] [--execute]` | `--execute` `--rollback` `--wait` | local state (and a sentinel in the legacy directory) | yes |
| `spec` | `comforge spec publish <TICKET> --title T --body-file FILE [--issue N] [--key K] [--grant FILE] [--execute]` | `--body-file` `--execute` `--grant` `--issue` `--key` `--title` | one GitHub issue | yes |
| `review` | `comforge review publish --review-file FILE [--grant FILE] [--execute] \| review list <PR>` | `--execute` `--grant` `--review-file` | one pull-request comment (publish) | yes |
| `comments` | `comforge comments <ISSUE\|PR>` | — | nothing | — |
| `prs` | `comforge prs [--state open\|closed\|all]` | `--state` | nothing | — |
| `artifact` | `comforge artifact <COMMIT> <PATH>` | — | nothing | — |
